notes.title: News! + Need feedback!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27499317/2bef7940b834df31620307d4979ee2bbf83dc9db.gif[/img]

[b]Hello to all of you, brave pilots! [/b]

[h1]We will launch a new project at the end of 2019, it is called: [b]JANGA[/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1106700/Janga/

[b]Why am I telling you this here? Because we will try to free ourselves for days regularly during the production of this game, to update our previous games.[/b]
 
Indeed, the community often asks us on Discord to fix bugs and make minor modifications on our previous games, but currently we have no time for that. It is therefore impossible for us to satisfy your expectations.
[b]We hope that this will change from September 2019!
[/b]
That's why I attach here the Grotoro feedback form, to recover any problems you may have, and maybe some new ideas you have to improve the game?

[h1][b]Over here for the Hyperun feedback form! https://forms.gle/iXDpNf5RYX8PG9NH8[/b][/h1]

Have a furious day! 

See ya on Discord!
http://discord.gg/a3qtypa

Concrete Games Team.

notes.title: Permanent discount
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27499317/12a1f286ee5120b1ae0591f2a19468302020804c.gif[/img]

[h1]Hello Hyperun pilots![/h1]

Although our game Hyperun received a very warm welcome from all these who played it, we also heard these who found it a bit too expensive. 

We find this criticism fair and we think that a [b]permanent discount[/b] could help the game reach more people. That’s why the game is [b]$5.99 (4.99€)[/b] from now on. 

[h1][b]A great thanks for your support to all these who paid the original price for it : you rock !!![/b][/h1]

[b]We wish you a furious and beautiful day![/b]

See ya on Discord!
http://discord.gg/a3qtypa

Concrete Games Team.

notes.title: Hyperun 1.0.1 Debug 'n' Smoothness Update! + SteamKeys contest!
notes.content:
[b]Retweet this tweet to have a chance to WIN A STEAM KEY NOW:[/b]
https://twitter.com/HyperunGame/status/925017993167466496


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohhwncuxyieNcamZi/giphy.gif[/img]

Here's the first Hyperun after release update!

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Huge replay performances optimisation, now play always at real speed
    [*]Replay loading and replay restart optimisation
    [*]900 & 1000 km/h achievements deleted
    [*]20,000,000 & 30,000,000 points achievements deleted
    [*]Save resolution settings when restart a run and restart the game
[/list]

[h1]Bugs fixes:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Lock controls during auto scale video settings
    [*]Sometimes it was impossible to watch replays
    [*]Replay HUD clean
    [*]Garage unloading optimised after replay start
    [*]Boost is now unlocked during the run not only at the end of it
    [*]Good image and behaviour for the sponsors icon in the customisation menu bar
    [*]After a boost unlock, sometimes this boost was locked again
    [*]Auto 60fps is now compatible with forced 60fps screens
[/list]

[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeBt9DawglWpXnAWyRnGdNeKNTNXwyrbTAhn0omEQtaj5HeaA/viewform?usp=sf_link]Feel free to send us feedback about your Hyperun experience/bugs/ask for new content in this form![/url]

[h1]Deluxe DLC is still coming soon![/h1]
[list]
    [*]Very old playable versions of the game
    [*]VProcedural OST application
    [*]VArt director commentary
[/list]

Have fun!

notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l378eggzQs5eDEgta/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Features:[/h1]
. Huge framerate optimization +  automatic render scalability + auto 60 & 120 fps
. Boost to 700 km/h can be unlocked
. New leaderboards (will be cleared the 8th of September for release)

. Lightning FX when you beat your high score
. GIF optimization
. Dark tunnels
. New tutorial levels

. Bike particle systems
. Post processes
. Birds spawn
. Save error
. Video options
. Sound options
. Garage unloading

notes.title: Update 0.5.1 - Juice Update
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xTeWOMY4qu1A9HTfLa/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Features:[/h1]
. New Musics
. New FX
. New Road visuals
. New Menus
. Localization in Russian, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, French, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), German
. Balancing: speed, level design (road algorithm)
. Life feedback
. Options (still work in progress)
. Palm trees
. Option to disable the GIF (increase performance a lot)

[h1]Bugs fixes:[/h1]
. frame drop at death
. instant death collision
. vehicle offset on some pattern
. ETH counter in menus
. Mouse issues in menus
. lower game file size
. Right/Left arrow color corrected at 700km/h
. global cleanup of project
